title: VTC Groups — Requests — Decide — payload
description: A group manager approves or declines a request to join; an approval admits the member, with a membership credential issued by the group's DID where the group issues credentials. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Optional; recorded with the decision and shown to managers. Not sent to the requester.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Requests — Decide — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/requests/decide/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/requests/decide/0.1#response.

credentialId.description: The membership credential offered, or null on a decline or where the group issues none.
